description: This file contains functions and methods for auditing HTTP requests in Kubernetes, including logging request metadata, handling impersonation, encoding objects, and managing managed fields in audit events.

methods.name: LogRequestMetadata
methods.description: Logs metadata of an HTTP request into an audit event, including timestamp, verb, URI, user agent, source IPs, and resource reference.

methods.name: LogImpersonatedUser
methods.description: Logs impersonated user information into an audit event.

methods.name: LogRequestObject
methods.description: Logs the request object into an audit event after encoding it, including resource metadata.

methods.name: LogRequestPatch
methods.description: Logs a request patch into an audit event.

methods.name: LogResponseObject
methods.description: Logs the response object into an audit event after encoding it.

methods.name: encodeObject
methods.description: Encodes a runtime object into JSON format for audit logging.

methods.name: maybeTruncateUserAgent
methods.description: Truncates the User-Agent string if it exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: copyWithoutManagedFields
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object without managed fields for privacy or size reduction.

methods.name: removeManagedFields
methods.description: Removes managed fields from a runtime object.

methods.name: shouldOmitManagedFields
methods.description: Determines whether to omit managed fields based on audit context configuration.
